#!/bin/bash

# Download the file
curl --output wachstum-recent.zip -X 'POST' \
  'https://www.regionalstatistik.de/genesisws/rest/2020/data/tablefile' \
  -H 'accept: application/octet-stream' \
  -H "username: $REGIONALSTATISTIK_USER" \
  -H "password: $REGIONALSTATISTIK_SECRET" \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \
  -d 'regionalkey=05515&compress=false&name=13111-01-03-4&area=free&timeslices=&classifyingkey1=&classifyingkey2=&classifyingkey3=&classifyingkey4=&classifyingkey5=&stand=01.01.1970%2001%3A00&classifyingvariable1=&format=ffcsv&classifyingvariable2=&language=de&endyear=&classifyingvariable3=&transpose=false&classifyingvariable4=&contents=&classifyingvariable5=&regionalvariable=&job=false&quality=off&startyear=2023'

# Unzip the file
unzip wachstum-recent.zip -d wachstum-recent

# Move and rename the file
mv wachstum-recent/13111-01-03-4_*.csv assets/data/wachstum-recent.csv

# Cleanup
rm -rf wachstum-recent
rm wachstum-recent.zip

exit 0
